conviction_note: Net of a well-sourced, under-modelled Q2 margin lever (NIO withdrew a RMB 10,000/unit purchase-tax subsidy mid-quarter, which is roughly 1:1 with the entire estimated non-GAAP profit line the market is watching) against softer Q3-guide and base-effect risk; small because this is the most heavily covered name in the window, 27m ADS/day, and the 9.76% implied move already carries most of the uncertainty.

findings.finding: NIO absorbed a RMB 10,000/vehicle purchase-tax subsidy on ES8 orders locked through 30 April 2026 and then discontinued it mid-Q2 — Deutsche Bank named that discontinuation as a cause of the June ES8 order shortfall. ES8 (Gen 3) was 33,474 units of Q2's 107,658, so removing RMB 10,000/unit from even ~18,000 Q2 deliveries retains ~RMB 180m of margin, which is the whole of Deutsche Bank's ~RMB 180m Q2 non-GAAP net income estimate. The 2.1% unit miss versus the 110-115k guide was in part the price paid for that margin, not purely demand weakness.
findings.why_not_priced: The delivery miss is a published monthly number every terminal has; the subsidy withdrawal that partly caused it is a line item disclosed only in Chinese-language promo terms and a CnEVPost analyst note, and it works in the opposite direction on the P&L. If the market had joined the two, the stock would not be sitting at its 52-week low on a 'profitability doubt' narrative into a quarter where the per-unit subsidy drag was actively being removed — you would see previews framing the unit miss as margin-accretive, and there are none.
findings.independence: Overlaps with finding 2 (both are opex/margin mechanisms behind the profitability run) but is a separate line of the P&L. Corroborated independently by the 2026-04-02 CnEVPost piece documenting the RMB 10,000 ES8 purchase-tax subsidy and its 30 April cutoff: https://cnevpost.com/2026/04/02/nio-es8-deliveries-16255-mar-2026/

findings.finding: NIO's 20-F for FY2025, filed 2026-04-10, discloses that headcount fell to 35,032 from 45,635 — 10,603 jobs, the sharpest single-year cut in its history — with product and software development down 40% to 6,912 from 11,528 and 'user experience' (sales, marketing, service) down 30.8% to 16,885 from 24,410. NIO never gave aggregate numbers during 2025, calling it 'organizational optimization'. Q2 2026 volume was +29% sequentially (107,658 vs 83,465) against that reduced cost base.
findings.why_not_priced: The aggregate figures exist only in an employee table deep in a 20-F; the wire coverage of that filing (StockTitan, Yahoo) carried the headline 'NIO files its annual report' with no headcount content, and the only outlets that extracted the numbers were a niche EV site and a LinkedIn post. If this were priced you would see it in the preview arithmetic as an explicit opex step-down, and consensus would not still be modelling a full-year loss of CN¥1.69/share. The negative tail is real too: cutting sales and service headcount 31% while launching two brands is a demand-execution risk, which is why the band spans zero.
findings.independence: Partially overlaps finding 1 (both explain the profitability turn). Independent secondary extraction of the same table: https://eletric-vehicles.com/nio/nio-discloses-10600-job-cuts-in-2025-with-40-of-rd-staff-eliminated/

findings.finding: NIO's year-on-year growth rate collapses mechanically from the August number onward on base effects, and 1 September is NIO's established monthly-delivery publication slot, so the August figure plausibly lands in the same tape as Q2 results and the Q3 guide. July 2026 was 35,934, +71.0% YoY against a July 2025 base of ~21,017. But August 2025 was 31,305 and September 2025 was 34,749 (Q3 2025 total 87,071) — the base steps up ~49% in one month. Bottom-up August 2026 indicators point to roughly flat-to-modestly-up sequentially (third-gen ES8's latest 10,000 units took 30 days as of 21 August; Onvo L60 at 3,201 units in the first 28 days), implying Q3 near 113-118k and YoY growth roughly halving to ~+30%.
findings.why_not_priced: The sell-side has these comps; the marginal holder of a $4.37 ADS does not, and the narrative in circulation is the '+71% year-on-year' July headline. The structural half of this is the sharper point: NIO filed monthly delivery 6-Ks on 2026-06-01, 2026-07-02 and 2026-08-03 for the prior month, so 1 September is the slot for August, and no aggregator flags that this print carries three releases at once. If the market had this, the front-expiry implied move would sit above the 9.76% single-event level to reflect a compound catalyst, and the put/call open interest ratio would not be 0.32.
findings.independence: Independent of findings 1, 2 and 4. Corroborated by the July 2026 delivery release (35,934, +71.0%): https://cnevpost.com/2026/08/01/nio-deliveries-jul-2026/ and the 6-K filing-date cadence on EDGAR.

findings.finding: NIO's smart-driving chief Ren Shaoqing has founded a separately registered embodied-AI/physical-AI-foundation-model company that has already reached a unicorn-level valuation, and NIO reportedly plans to make a strategic investment in it while Ren stays on as NIO's smart-driving chief. Reported 21 and 24 August 2026, after NIO's last public communication.
findings.why_not_priced: It broke in Chinese-language and China-EV trade press in the nine days before the print and has no US wire pickup; NIO has not confirmed it and it is not in any filing. It is a divided-attention and related-party-transaction question in the single most valuation-sensitive function, and it is the kind of item that gets asked on the 8:00 a.m. call rather than in the release. If it were priced there would be a sell-side note on smart-driving key-man risk; there is none. Sign is genuinely ambiguous — on a $4 stock with calls bid, a robotics affiliation can be read as a positive optionality headline, which is why the band crosses zero.
findings.independence: Independent of all other findings. Second, earlier report of the same facts from a different angle: https://cnevpost.com/2026/08/21/nio-ren-shaoqing-ventures-into-embodied-robotics-report/

findings.finding: NIO has now missed its own delivery guidance in consecutive disclosures — June 2026 came in at 40,597 against a 42,900-47,900 guide, and Q2 at 107,658 against 110,000-115,000 — so whatever Q3 unit and revenue range management gives on 1 September starts with an impaired discount factor.
findings.why_not_priced: Weakest of the five and closest to priced — the individual misses are public. What is not in the coverage is that they are consecutive and both attributable to NIO's own promotional withdrawals rather than to the market, which changes how a fresh guide should be read. Sized small precisely because most of this is in the -9.2% twenty-day drift already.
findings.independence: Overlaps finding 1, which supplies the mechanism for both misses. Q2 guide range and actual also in the same release.

searched_and_found_nothing: HKEX 9866 'Monthly Returns of Equity Issuer on Movements in Securities' for June/July 2026 — the one primary source that would show share issuance and dilution not visible in any SEC filing. Not reachable via search or fetch; no substitute found.

Weekly China EV insurance-registration data for August 2026 (CnEVPost, CarNewsChina, itiger). The search index repeatedly returned August 2025 articles relabelled as 2026 — the recurring '8,163 units week ending Aug 31' figure is 2025 data (URL path /2025/09/). No verifiable 2026 weekly series obtained; I discarded it rather than use it.

China's record 4.3m-vehicle door-handle recall ordered 26 August 2026 — nine automakers, Tesla, Xiaomi and Leapmotor named. NIO is not among them, so no incremental warranty cost. https://chinaglobalsouth.com/2026/08/26/china-global-auto-safety-shift-record-recall/
'Nio begins European layoffs to cut global costs by 25%' — checked and dated 4 April 2025, not current. Dead lead.

NIO 100-kWh battery pack price cut with retroactive RMB 20,000 customer vouchers — looked like a large unmodelled accrual, but the source URL is /2025/08/19/. An August 2025 event, not 2026. Dead lead.
Insider transactions and Form 4 clusters — NIO is a foreign private issuer, its insiders are exempt from Section 16, and no Form 4s exist for this CIK.

Any 6-K, press release or quiet filing between 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-31: EDGAR's 6-K list ends at the 2026-08-20 earnings-date notice and StockTitan's NIO feed has nothing after it. The eleven-day pre-print window is genuinely empty.

Per-brand ASP or gross margin for Onvo and Firefly — NIO has never disclosed these and no third party publishes them, so the brand-mix margin question the sweep flagged cannot be quantified from public sources. Only NIO-brand average transaction price is available (RMB 434,600 July, RMB 443,000 June).
A follow-on NIO Power funding round or further CATL transaction after the January 2026 five-year deal and CATL's RMB 2.5bn investment — nothing new since.

Q3 2026 sell-side delivery/revenue consensus as a specific number — only full-year 2026 figures (revenue CN¥130.3bn, EPS -CN¥1.69, price target $6.72) were sourceable, so I could not measure a guide against a quantified bar.
baseline_tension: The baseline's two directional signals contradict each other and I think the skew is the unreliable one: spot is at its 52-week low, -9.15% over twenty days, which says equity holders are braced for bad news, while a -9.44 vol-point 25-delta skew and a 0.32 put/call OI ratio say upside is being paid for — on a $4.37 ADS at 104.5% IV that call bid is far more likely a retail lottery-ticket structure than an informed directional statement, so I have not penalised my two positive findings for nominally agreeing with it. My strongest finding cuts squarely against the run-up: the price has capitalised the Q2 delivery miss as demand failure, whereas the withdrawn RMB 10,000/unit purchase-tax subsidy makes that miss partly the cost of the margin the market says it wants. My bearish findings agree with the run-up and are therefore the more likely of the two to be already priced, which is why the net is only +1.8 against a 9.76% implied move.
